## Download

**`iPhoneMonitor.zip`** — unzip anywhere and run `iPhoneMonitor.exe`.

SHA256: `{{SHA256}}`

## Before you start

1. Install **Apple Devices** from the Microsoft Store (provides the Apple Mobile Device Service).
2. Connect the iPhone with a data cable, unlock it and tap **Trust This Computer**.
3. *(Optional)* For CPU / memory, enable Developer Mode on the iPhone.

The exe is not code-signed: if SmartScreen warns, click **More info → Run anyway**.

## 下载与使用

下载 **`iPhoneMonitor.zip`**，解压后双击 `iPhoneMonitor.exe`。使用前先在微软商店安装 **Apple Devices**，插线后在手机上点「信任此电脑」。想看 CPU / 内存需要在 iPhone 上开启开发者模式。exe 没有数字签名，如果出现「已保护你的电脑」，点「更多信息 → 仍要运行」。

See the [README](https://github.com/by1907047/iphone_monitor#readme) · [中文说明](https://github.com/by1907047/iphone_monitor/blob/main/README.zh-CN.md)
